records.title: ANCHOR POLICY
pages:
A BOUNDARY MAY BE STABILISED
BY A PERSON.

THE PERSON MUST REMAIN.
THE PERSON MUST BE FED.

THE PERSON IS NOT A PRISONER.
(TERM STRUCK)
